$description: Oxyn design tokens. DTCG 2025.10 format. Tiers: primitive -> semantic -> theme. Motion lives in oxyn.motion.json.

primitive.$description: Tier 1. Raw values with no meaning. Only semantic and theme tokens may reference them.

color.$description: Raw palette. Never referenced by components directly; themes alias these.

neutral.$description: Warm grey. 0 = white, 1000 = black. 50 and 950 are brand pins.

amber-soft.$description: Low-chroma amber (45 % chroma) for quiet states.

rust-soft.$description: Low-chroma rust (45 % chroma) for quiet states.

violet-soft.$description: Low-chroma violet (45 % chroma) for quiet states.

green-soft.$description: Low-chroma green (45 % chroma) for quiet states.

space.$description: 4 px grid; key = px. 2 and 6 are the only off-grid half steps.

semantic.$description: Tier 2. Theme-independent roles (type, space, shape, layers). Colour roles live per theme in Tier 3.

dev.oxyn.note: Numbers that change (timers, counts, +12 −3) use tabular figures: CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; GPUI FontFeatures tnum. U+2212 minus has the same advance as + in both families.

bubble-grouped.$description: Bubble corner nearest the avatar when grouped

touch-target.$description: Minimum hit area on touch surfaces

density.$description: Two modes. comfortable is the default; compact is IDE panels and dense lists.

z.$description: Stacking layers. Approval sits above toasts: a decision is never covered.

disabled.$description: icons.md Disabled; fall back to fg.disabled if < 3:1

tint.$description: Hover tint of a source region (merge-conflict.md)

voice.$description: The audio luminance cap (±10 %, 3 Hz low-pass) is motion.audio.luminance-max / -lowpass in oxyn.motion.json; not duplicated here.

motion.$description: Motion tokens (dur.*, ease.*, spring.*, loop.*, motion.reduced) live in tokens/oxyn.motion.json.

theme.$description: Tier 3. Colour, elevation and focus per theme. Every theme has the same keys. Consumers strip the 'theme.<name>.' prefix: theme.dark.color.fg.default -> color.fg.default.

ring.$description: 2 px ring, offset {semantic.focus.offset}; keyboard focus only, no animation.

light.$description: Paper surfaces, ink text; rust darkened for text.

ring.$description: 2 px ring, offset {semantic.focus.offset}; keyboard focus only, no animation.

hc-dark.$description: High contrast: text >= 7:1, UI >= 4.5:1; no shadows, no shimmer.

elevation.$description: High contrast uses borders (border.strong) instead of shadows; all shadows are transparent.

ring.$description: 2 px ring, offset {semantic.focus.offset}; keyboard focus only, no animation.
